tasks.title: Establish current baseline and execution environment
write_scope: Cargo.lock (generate only through Cargo; review resolved dependencies)
Minimal baseline build repairs only under an additional coordinator-approved file lease
read_scope: Actual deployed wrapper and current native build metadata
implementation_steps: Identify the user's current branch and uncommitted changes; do not replace it with the reviewed ZIP.
Compare the targeted files in SOURCE-REVIEW.md and record any local fixes or newer features. Check whether the installed binary corresponds to this checkout.
Record compiler, target OS/architecture, Tauri/Wry resolved versions, webview runtime, current profile configuration, and actual wrapper assets/headers. Redact account information.
Run baseline checks, distinguishing old failures from environment blockers. Generate/commit the application lockfile only after real dependency resolution.
Verify available Codex models/efforts, existing AGENTS rules, and the support matrix. Establish the file-lease ledger.
acceptance: Current checkout/deployment fingerprint and baseline outcomes are recorded.
Missing platforms or account-interaction requirements are explicit.
No user source/settings/profile is overwritten.
checks: Existing browser suites when their documented runtime prerequisites are available
non_goals: No feature implementation beyond separately approved baseline repairs.
Do not repeat prior test counts without rerunning them.

tasks.title: Rebrand visibly and replace the tagline exactly
write_scope: Title/startup strings only in src-tauri/src/player.rs and main.rs
README.md and relevant UI test fixtures
implementation_steps: Use MPD Viewer for visible application branding and the exact tagline View fav channels in priority.
Set productName to MPD Viewer; preserve POC/build labeling separately.
Keep the stable bundle ID, config/profile paths, Rust package name, commands, public Client ID, and parent hostname.
Update literal-dependent fixtures. Add an intentional-legacy-name allowlist; historical verification documents remain accurate.
Record the optional owner action to rename the Twitch registration display name; do not change the developer account.
acceptance: Manager, native viewer, installer display fields, and wrapper title show the requested brand.
Tagline string matches exactly, without rewriting fav to favorite.
Upgrade fixture retains existing preferences and legacy identifiers.
checks: Configuration regression tests including unchanged identifier/client ID/origin
Native upgrade/install display-name check when installers are available
non_goals: No global tabber-to-viewer replacement.
No Rust crate/binary rename or database/profile migration.

tasks.title: Diagnose viewer login and the Turbo ad observation
write_scope: A disposable auth-spike worktree; experimental changes are NOT merged
implementation_steps: Reproduce and distinguish monitoring OAuth, normal-browser login, chat identity, and native video session.
Record the existing deny-all popup and navigation policies; determine the actual profile sharing before proposing new paths.
Run the comparison matrix in PLAN.md with the user performing login/MFA. Collect only redacted errors and observations.
Experiment with official login popup handling and related-view configuration. Identify exact required origins and any storage-access limitations.
Decide whether retaining Twitch.Player plus separate official chat is viable. Recommend combined Twitch.Embed only with evidence and an approved ADR.
Return a supported, unsupported, or blocked result per runtime. Identify the likely cause only to the confidence supported by evidence.
acceptance: A reproducible sequence and falsifiable diagnosis are provided, or the exact missing evidence is named.
No claim that API authorization proves website sign-in or Turbo.
Popup/profile requirements are concrete inputs to MV-001/MV-021.
checks: Normal Twitch page vs hosted wrapper vs native viewer comparisons
Actual ads or missing sign-in documented without credentials
non_goals: No ad blocking, unsupported APIs, browser-security flags, cookie copying, or password capture.
No production patches or website deployment from spike code.

tasks.title: Prove native grid and retained-surface moves
write_scope: A disposable grid-spike worktree; experimental changes are NOT merged
implementation_steps: Prototype two hosted child webviews inside a separate native grid window; retain the privileged manager separately.
Check tested Tauri feature/version requirements; record dependency pins and any unsupported OS constraints.
Test bounds, display scaling, focus, keyboard interaction, popup ownership, minimize/restore, and back-and-forth reparenting.
Observe whether DOM, playback, session/profile, and chat draft survive a move; never infer this only from a method returning Ok.
Test the native caller identity needed for telemetry and safe scrolling/clipping of child views.
Return a capability matrix: retained move, recreate move, grid supported/unsupported. Propose an ADR fallback instead of a broad engine rewrite.
acceptance: At least one real native reproduction or a specific blocked-environment report.
No claim that the current unstable API is portable without platform evidence.
Grid means one window, not tiled standalone windows.
checks: Bidirectional reparent with a paused and playing surface
Caller identity and cross-surface report attempt
non_goals: No full docking framework.
No manager permissions on remote grid children.
No release merge of throwaway prototype.

tasks.title: Freeze minimal authentication and presentation contracts
implementation_steps: Choose the official chat embed implementation, popup/profile strategy, and platform support policy.
Freeze logical session vs native surface vs container identity, per-surface telemetry binding, and close semantics.
Define backward-compatible wrapper negotiation and settings migration ownership.
Decide retained or deliberate recreate mode switching by supported runtime; define rollback and failure visibility.
Lease shared native, wrapper, and manager paths to nonoverlapping tasks. Keep implementation interfaces small.
acceptance: Subsequent agents have explicit actions/events/state, permission boundaries, defaults, and error behavior.
Each unresolved native limitation is a gate or an explicit fallback decision—not an assumption.
No conflicting simultaneous leases on shared files.
checks: Check planned protocol against the existing deny_unknown_fields report
non_goals: No broad refactor in the contract task.
No final support claim based on a documentation page alone.

tasks.title: Implement shared viewer profile and constrained login popups
write_scope: src-tauri/src/model.rs and controller.rs for bounded auth commands/events only
implementation_steps: Reuse the identified persistent app-owned playback profile for all viewers and login popups. Preserve existing sessions when possible.
Implement official popup handling using native opener/features/environment relationships and the audited destination policy.
Keep auth windows unprivileged and out of playback capacity accounting; bound and track their lifecycle.
Provide manager-origin sign-in and explicit safe viewer-session reset primitives if supported; preserve OAuth Disconnect as a different action.
Respect normal storage/cookie restrictions and expose unsupported-runtime failures. Do not fake a login/Turbo success state.
Avoid logging auth query strings, cookies, passwords, or raw identity-provider responses.
acceptance: Official login works on each claimed supported runtime with the user entering credentials.
Second viewer uses the intended profile; persistence and reset behavior are documented.
Arbitrary popup/navigation attempts are denied and auth windows have no native app authority.
checks: Destination parser tests including lookalike hosts, credentials-in-URL, non-HTTPS and redirect changes
Negative command/telemetry checks from auth window
non_goals: No cookie import from Chrome/Firefox.
No automatic consent/privacy bypass.
No token persistence redesign.

tasks.title: Add official per-channel chat to the hosted and Demo wrapper
read_scope: Approved embed choice and popup policy
implementation_steps: Add an official per-channel chat iframe using validated channel and actual parent hostname; keep the existing video adapter unless ADR-001 changes it.
Enable chat by default, implement explicit collapse/restore without player reconstruction, and use responsive side/stack geometry.
Adjust only necessary wrapper frame policy. Coordinate native frame-navigation changes through the owning native task.
Keep video independent of chat errors and report unsupported chat/login behavior honestly.
Add clearly simulated Demo chat with no Twitch requests. Preserve volume-before-first-play and no periodic unpause behavior.
acceptance: Chat channel always matches viewer channel.
Chat toggle preserves the same player instance, audio, pause, and session.
Video meets minimum geometry and chat does not obscure it.
Real native chat posting/login is covered by later acceptance, not inferred from mocks.
checks: Mock chat failure and channel replacement
Collapsed/restored player identity and no extra play calls
non_goals: No custom chat client, chatbot, chat OAuth scope, or combined-embed migration without ADR approval.
No deployment during implementation.

tasks.title: Make API connection and viewer sign-in distinct in the manager
implementation_steps: Label API state as live-status/monitoring authorization, not proof of signed-in playback.
Add user-triggered viewer sign-in entry and honest Unknown/user-confirmed state where no official verification exists.
Expose explicit viewer-session reset only with a clear confirmation and explanation of what is cleared.
Keep API Disconnect separate; do not display an unverified Turbo-active badge.
Show actionable popup/runtime/login failures without exposing secrets.
acceptance: A user can distinguish both authentication concepts before starting viewers.
Viewer-session reset never silently disconnects monitoring or deletes favorites.
No API-connected status implies ad-free playback.
checks: Manager command dispatch and permission checks
No credential fields or cookie contents in UI state
non_goals: No native-auth implementation in this UI task.
No automatic Turbo detection claim.

tasks.title: Version the wrapper protocol and preserve old clients
read_scope: Old v1 Report and three-asset server
Existing hosted update script and remote permissions
implementation_steps: Implement the approved bounded hello/version handshake without breaking v1 deny_unknown_fields payloads.
Keep old and new client/wrapper combinations explicit. Reject incompatible versions with an actionable error, not repeated reloads.
Bind telemetry/hello to native caller ownership under the approved contract. Register every new command in the build manifest and capabilities.
Keep Demo bundled assets and deployed asset manifest synchronized. Retain restrictive manager isolation.
Prepare immutable version-path deployment packaging on the existing parent host; retain the v1 root for old clients.
acceptance: Old client/new wrapper and new client/old wrapper behavior matches the compatibility table.
No widening of manager permissions to remote pages.
Native and wrapper agree on supported feature/version metadata.
checks: Native denial of unauthorized hello/report calls
non_goals: No replacement of root hosted assets without authorization.
No migration to a new parent hostname.

tasks.title: Extract surface presentation while preserving standalone behavior
write_scope: Scoped presenter/lifecycle tests and caller capability adjustments
implementation_steps: Split static wrapper hosting from surface creation/audio/focus/closure.
Introduce logical session, native surface instance, and container tracking using the frozen minimal interface.
Convert direct get_webview_window assumptions to adapter operations and actual surface ownership.
Bind reports to native surface identity and reject old epochs. Keep telemetry advisory.
Introduce fake adapter delayed callbacks and distinguish programmatic close reasons from manual Skip.
Leave all viewers standalone in this task and prove behavior equivalence before adding grid.
acceptance: Current priority, capacity, skip, retry, audio, auth/chat, Stop/Quit behavior remains intact.
Late surface events cannot alter another session or resurrect a stopped one.
No new grid UI ships in this refactor commit.
checks: Fake presenter delayed create/destroy and stale report tests
Manual close vs programmatic close semantics
non_goals: No scheduling policy changes or generalized docking library.
No unrelated formatting churn across the repository.

tasks.title: Implement true grid container and geometry
write_scope: Necessary presenter wiring and feature gates
implementation_steps: Create a dedicated native grid window hosting each selected surface at its own bounds.
Keep manager privileges out of all hosted surfaces; preserve profile and popup behavior.
Implement deterministic priority-ordered geometry using logical units and display scaling.
Account for video, chat and chrome minimums. Use the proven scroll/clipping or clear insufficient-space strategy from the ADR.
Test geometry in isolation and real native interaction. Do not silently hide chat, reduce capacity, or start off-screen playback tricks.
acceptance: Grid is one native container with per-channel video and chat surfaces.
No video is shrunk below the required minimum to fit an arbitrary count.
Focus, chat keyboard input, resize and native popup work as tested.
checks: Geometry tests for 1,2,3,4,6 plus overflow counts
Different DPI/scaling and screen work areas
Keyboard focus and chat input in neighboring cells
non_goals: No global switching state machine yet.
No OS-level tiling presented as the completed feature.

tasks.title: Implement safe layout transitions, cleanup, and persistence
implementation_steps: Add controller-owned layout revisions and pending/committed state.
Implement retained-surface moves where supported and explicit close-confirm-recreate fallback where approved.
Preserve logical selection and desired audio; never exceed reserved capacity by opening duplicates.
Make Stop/exit, preemption, and cap reduction supersede moves; reject stale callbacks.
Differentiate grid close (Stop), standalone user close (Skip), and empty container cleanup (neither).
Persist layout preference and valid geometry with backward-compatible defaults. Preserve existing app/config/profile identities; restore no playback automatically.
acceptance: Switching both directions never accidentally skips channels or leaves duplicate playback.
Stop during every transition stage leaves no viewer/popup orphan and no later reopen.
Old preferences load as standalone; saved valid layout survives restart without autoplay.
Failed movement or creation produces an explicit recoverable state.
checks: Close-grid, stop, preempt, lower-cap and repeated-toggle races
Simulated lost destroy event and registry sweep
Missing monitor/off-screen restore and old settings fixtures
non_goals: No mixed dock/standalone mode unless separately approved.
No silent removal of the background-playback uncertainty.

tasks.title: Expose layout selection and state in the manager
implementation_steps: Add Standalone/Grid setting with current, pending, failed and supported states.
Keep rank controls distinct from presentation order; focus a grid viewer through its surface.
Show brief reload disclosure for recreate-only platforms and explanatory space errors.
Reflect the committed setting only after backend success; display real failure/rollback states.
Keep controls keyboard-accessible and avoid granting layout authority to remote wrapper content.
acceptance: User can switch modes and understand in-progress/error/reload conditions.
A failed backend change does not misleadingly show success.
Selection count and volume semantics remain unchanged.
checks: Action dispatch and pending/committed UI tests
Priority order vs display mode separation
non_goals: No cross-platform support claims based on UI availability alone.
No unrelated visual redesign.

tasks.title: Independently review security and lifecycle invariants
write_scope: None: read-only reviewer returns findings; coordinator writes docs/mpd-viewer-v0.2/reports/security-review.md
read_scope: All changed native command, profile, popup, capability, wrapper and presentation paths
implementation_steps: Trace the actual native caller from auth popup, Twitch iframe, wrapper surface, and manager to each command.
Attempt cross-surface spoofing, capability union escalation, hostile redirects and popup abuse.
Review profile preservation/reset, redaction, unknown protocol behavior, and hosted-v1 compatibility.
Trace Stop/preempt/cap-decrease races and programmatic destruction. Check for duplicate playback and orphan popups.
Return prioritized file/line findings with reproducible tests. Fixes go back to the owning implementation task, then are re-reviewed.
acceptance: No open critical/high privilege, credential, data-loss, or duplicate-playback issue.
Native checks are distinguished from static review and mocks.
Review is independent of the code-author run.
checks: Native negative IPC and popup checks on claimed platforms
Reproduction of each substantive finding or clear static proof
non_goals: No implementation patches during this review run.
No password/cookie requests or storage-security bypass.

tasks.title: Run regression and real-runtime acceptance matrix
implementation_steps: Rerun baseline and focused suites after integration; record actual command output, not inherited counts.
Run real native chat/login/profile/Turbo comparisons with user-performed account interactions.
Exercise 1,2,3,4,6 selected viewers across modes, paused/blocked playback, cap changes and selection swaps.
Exercise sleep/wake, network loss, minimize/restore, failed moves, stop/quit, shared profile and reset.
Verify upgrade preferences/branding and real CSP/ACL enforcement.
Record support per OS/runtime. Any unavailable target remains blocked/unverified; it does not inherit another platform's pass.
acceptance: Each required gate has an actual passed/failed/blocked result and evidence location.
No critical regression or privilege issue remains.
Ad observations and authentication claims reflect native evidence, not model inference.
checks: Full native/Rust suite and targeted Node/Python/browser suites
non_goals: No production-code fixes without a new file lease and owning-task review.
No treating mock no-sandbox/CSP-stripped harness behavior as native proof.

tasks.title: Package compatible release and deployment handoff
write_scope: Versioned wrapper build/package scripts and manifest
read_scope: Existing hosted site version and immutable artifact policy
implementation_steps: Package MPD Viewer binaries/source and matching immutable hosted wrapper assets with hashes/build IDs.
Keep the old root/v1 site available; produce the explicit native/wrapper compatibility matrix and rollback instructions.
Review client ID, parent hostname, legacy identity preservation, and developer-application display-name checklist.
List exact tested platforms/runtimes and limitations; do not label untested native builds supported.
Create deployment instructions. Publish remotely only after an explicit separate instruction identifying the destination.
acceptance: Artifact names/visible branding use MPD Viewer.
Wrapper assets form a compatible, versioned set with rollback.
Release notes distinguish implemented features, tested behavior and blocked support gates.
checks: Clean install/upgrade checks for packaged targets
non_goals: No unapproved deployment, DNS/account changes, or silent old-client replacement.
